info.name: Find where a part or assembly is used.

params.name: documentId
params.description: Document that contains the part or assembly.

params.name: elementId
params.description: Element that contains the part or assembly.

params.name: versionId
params.description: Version that contains the part or assembly. One of `versionId` and `useLatestVersion` is required.

params.name: configuration
params.description: URL-encoded string of configuration values (separated by `;`). See the [Configurations API Guide](https://onshape-public.github.io/docs/api-adv/configs/) for details.

params.name: partId
params.description: Part to find. When `elementId` is a Part Studio, `partId` or `partNumber` is required. Call [getPartsWMVE](https://cad.onshape.com/glassworks/explorer/#/Part/getPartsWMVE) to get a list of parts in the Part Studio.

params.name: partNumber
params.description: Part to find. When `elementId` is a Part Studio, `partId` or `partNumber` is required. Call [getPartsWMVE](https://cad.onshape.com/glassworks/explorer/#/Part/getPartsWMVE) to get a list of parts in the Part Studio.

params.name: includeProperties
params.description: If true, include metadata properties for each result item.

params.name: filter
params.description: Filter results by one of the following:  `0: LATEST_REVISION, 1: ALL_REVISIONS, 2: ALL_VERSIONS (default), 3: ALL, 5: LATEST_VERSIONS, 6: MOST_RECENT_REVISION`.

params.name: includeVersionInfo
params.description: If `true`, include the list of document versions in which the queried item has been referenced by other documents. Each entry contains the version ID and name.

params.name: useLatestVersion
params.description: If `true`, automatically resolves to the most recent referenced document version for the queried item. One of `versionId` and `useLatestVersion` is required.

params.name: limitToTypes
params.description: Comma-separated list of element types to limit results to. Valid values: `0: PARTSTUDIO, 1: ASSEMBLY, 2: DRAWING`.

items.docs: Only supported for Enterprise and Professional plans. See [Dev Docs: Where Used](https://onshape-public.github.io/docs/api-adv/relmgmt/#where-used) for a tutorial on using this endpoint.
